hotels.title: Five-Star Hyatt Regency Tashkent Elegance in Uzbekistan’s Vibrant Capital
hotels.description: Set in the heart of Uzbekistan’s capital, this polished retreat places you steps from Amir Timur Square and a short drive from the blue-tiled grandeur of Hazrati Imam Complex and Chorsu Bazaar. Contemporary rooms and suites pair sleek lines with marble bathrooms, while many overlook Tashkent’s broad boulevards. Between city explorations, swim in the indoor pool, visit the spa or dine on refined local and international cuisine at Khiva Restaurant. The Opera Bar serves cocktails and light plates, and the nearby Navoi Theatre anchors one of Tashkent’s most elegant cultural quarters
